name: std::indirect_result_t

declarations.code:
template <class F, class... Is>

    requires(std::indirectly_readable<Is> && ...) &&

    std::invocable<F, std::iter_reference_t<Is>...>

using indirect_result_t = std::invoke_result_t<F, std::iter_reference_t<Is>...>;

intro: The alias template indirect_result_t obtains the result type of invoking an invocable type F on the result of dereferencing indirectly_readable types Is....
